functions.name: runLayeredDesign
functions.description: Start an asynchronous layered marketing design job. Returns a jobId immediately; the design is not finished when this returns. Do not wait; check later with getLayeredDesignStatus.

requestJson.description: Serialized JSON start request: requestId, brief, referenceImageUrl and optional canvas and assets fields.

functions.name: getLayeredDesignStatus
functions.description: Retrieve progress or artifact references for a layered design job. Returns status QUEUED, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, SUCCEEDED_WITH_WARNINGS or FAILED with the current stage. SUCCEEDED_WITH_WARNINGS carries usable HTML that has unresolved findings: check needsReview and publishReady before publishing.
